$comment: The style lock. Every generated sticker shares this verbatim — that is the whole point of the engine. Change it only when you intend to re-generate the ENTIRE set, and bump `version` when you do so stale art is detectable.
medium: flat vector sticker illustration, thick uniform outline, minimal interior detail
lineWeight: bold even-weight contour line, roughly 6% of the icon's width, no line tapering
shading: flat fills only, no gradients, no drop shadows, no ambient occlusion
composition: single centered subject, filling 85% of a square frame, nothing cropped by the edge
background: fully transparent background, no backdrop, no ground shadow, no frame, no border
readability: must stay legible when scaled down to 44 pixels tall
text: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature

palette.$comment: Mirrors the constants at the top of the kiosk script in public/index.html. Keep in sync.

paletteRule: use ONLY these colors: deep forest green #123B26, warm cream #F7F1E3, teak brown #8A5A34, butter yellow #E8B84B, and at most one accent from soft red #D94F4F / dusty pink #F2A8C0 / sky blue #4FA3C4
mood: warm, cozy, retro Korean cafe stationery; charming but restrained; hand-drawn warmth with geometric discipline

output.note: Square with real transparency. If the source cannot emit alpha, generate on a solid #FF00FF magenta field so the key color can be removed cleanly.
